attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: If theattribute is set to 0 (button), a mouse click onhighlights it for as long as the mouse is held down, sending aout the left outlet when the mouse button is pressed down, and anotherout the left outlet when the mouse button is released. The button text is also sent out the middle outlet on mouse click.If theattribute is set to 1 (toggle), and the initial state of the toggle is 0,is set to 'on', a 1 is sent out the left outlet and themessage is displayed and set out the middle outlet.If initial state of the toggle is 1,is set to 'off', a 0 is sent out the left outlet and themessage is displayed and set out the middle outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: The behavior depends on the currentsettings.0 (button): Amessage will re-trigger the object's output.1 (trigger): Amessage will switch the object's state and trigger the output.

messages.name: float
messages.description: At float message is converted to. See thelisting for usage.

messages.name: int
messages.description: If theattribute is set to 0 (button), a bang is sent out the left outlet, and themessage is displayed and set out the middle outlet.If theattribute is set to 1 (toggle), and the number input is 1,is set to 'on', a 1 is sent out the left outlet and themessage is displayed and set out the middle outlet.If the number input is 0,is set to 'off', a 0 is sent out the left outlet and themessage is displayed and set out the middle outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Sets toggle state with no output
messages.description: If theattribute is set to 1 (toggle), themessage toggles the on or off state without sending anything out the outlets. The word, followed by any non-zero number, sets toggle to on;sets it to off.

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.description: If theattribute is set to 1 (toggle), the word, followed by either theorsymbol, causes theto display that symbol, but does not cause any output. The symbol is case-sensitive.

messages.name: symbol
messages.description: If theattribute is set to 1 (toggle), the word, followed by either theorsymbol, causesto display that symbol, switch to the toggle state, and trigger the corresponding output.
